description: (needs account token) Removes one email address from a site's domain. Mail to it stops. A mailbox's stored mail is deleted. The main inbox is not removed here. confirm=true applies it. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: remove_email_address
title: Remove email address
